name: short-68-in-128-out
prompt: Explain how an inference server uses prefill and decode. Compare TTFT, token latency, batching, KV cache, and throughput. Give a concise technical answer for an engineer evaluating model serving.

name: long-142-in-256-out
prompt: You are evaluating a transformer inference service. Analyze how prompt prefill, autoregressive decode, attention computation, key-value cache allocation, GPU memory bandwidth, batching, queueing, request concurrency, time to first token, inter-token latency, and end-to-end latency interact. Explain the likely bottlenecks for short and long prompts, how to measure each bottleneck, what tradeoffs appear when increasing batch size, and how a service should choose an operating point using latency SLOs and goodput. Organize the answer with headings and avoid unsupported performance claims.
